source.note: Harbor's public main. The benchmark's in-progress branches were cut from stage-0.1.7 (01f865140f7a9f40da5784467be1be7955d2f156), which is six commits ahead and not yet public; it holds an unreleased security change, so it is not imported until Harbor publishes it. None of the branches touches a file that differs between the two commits.

exclude.reason: Its provenance note says the request patterns were adapted from a review of saved Harbor chats (real history). Only service/corpus.py:live_cases() reads it, lazily; nothing in the benchmark calls it.

not_imported.reason: The Harbor Mac app (Swift). The benchmark drives the Python backend, not the app.
Harbor's browser extension; not part of the benchmark.
Release, packaging and signing tooling. build-support/engine_guard/ is imported: it defines the patches Harbor applies to oMLX (the baseline engine), and tests/test_power_tier.py reads it.
Deployment and host tooling for Harbor.
Harbor's third-party integrations; not used by the harnesses.
Side-device node (MacBook Air). Not needed; pytest.ini still lists air/tests, which pytest skips when absent.
Side-device node (Mac mini).
Training data and LoRA tooling.

not_imported.reason: The Harbor iPhone app itself. Only the MLX Swift package (ios/Packages/HarborLing) is imported for the iPhone runner to reuse. ios/App/OnDeviceModel.swift and ios/Sources/HarborCore/LocalInference.swift are the next candidates if the runner needs them.
